summary: Tested the new onboarding, Insights/Copilot and Reach features from end to end (pytest: 17 of 18 pass; Playwright on desktop 1920 and mobile 390). Almost everything works: the onboarding gate, all 3 onboarding steps (goal saved, LinkedIn demo account linked with a toast, live audit done in about 23s, then /insights with onboarded=true), opportunity tabs with correct counts, Ask/Deep dive buttons, Copilot starters and follow-ups in one thread, the Reach page (totals, curve, trend, table, Google 'unavailable' message, account scoping), the old routes and sidebar nav, sharp corners with offset-shadow hovers, and no page-level horizontal overflow at 390px. Main problems: (1) LLM output is often cut off mid-sentence because max_tokens is too low for claude-sonnet-5-5; (2) 'Change goal' sets onboarded=false and wipes the saved business name, ROAS and budget; (3) an unknown account_id or platform returns 500 on every scoped analytics endpoint.

critical.issue: max_tokens is too low for claude-sonnet-5-5 (the model uses hidden reasoning tokens). In a direct probe at max_tokens=900, 5 of 5 calls ended with finish_reason='length' and produced 0 text; at 3000, 5 of 5 ended with 'stop' and complete text. In stored data, 3 of the last 5 agent narratives are cut mid-sentence (e.g. '...UK Retail Buyers at $10,997, Broad LAL'), and Copilot answers (max_tokens=1400) are cut too (e.g. '...fatiguing at 3.9x frequency, so'). An empty reply silently drops to the deterministic fallback.

minor.endpoint: GET /api/v1/insights/reach, /insights/opportunities, /pulse with an unknown account_id or platform (e.g. ?account_id=nope, ?platform=foo)
minor.issue: Returns 500 with KeyError 'date' in adintel/analytics/dataset.py load_raw (line 20) when the filtered frame is empty. It should return an empty or 'unavailable' payload, or a 404/400.

The narrative compares 7-day portfolio spend ($84.6K) with the user's MONTHLY budget ($50K) ('running well above the $50,000 monthly budget'). The prompt mixes time periods. Meanwhile the Budget opportunity card uses a different budget (353,994 USD) and ignores the workspace monthly_budget.
Errors after the first chunk are swallowed with a bare except and nothing is logged, so partial answers are saved as complete.

ui_bugs.issue: saveGoal always sends onboarded:false, and GoalStep only prefills the goal (name/ROAS/budget start empty). An already-onboarded user who changes the goal and then clicks 'Back to app' (or just leaves) loses business_name/target_roas/monthly_budget and is forced back to /welcome on the next reload. Reproduced: workspace became {goal:scale_reach, onboarded:false, business_name:null}, and reloading /insights redirected to /welcome.

integration_issues.issue: The run starts with the opportunity's agent_query, but the /agent textarea still shows the default 'Full Cross-Channel Audit' chip and query text, so the request on screen does not match the running investigation.
If a card's 'Ask how' is clicked while Copilot is busy, ask() returns early and the seed is cleared, so the question is silently dropped.

issues: Meta and LinkedIn lines/legend use nearly the same blue, so they are hard to tell apart
The last x-axis tick label ('Nov 6') is clipped at the right edge
The frequency vs cost-per-sale chart has no legend saying the bars are CPA and the line is CTR
Card copy shows raw unformatted money ('Spending 11,715 USD/week', 'Projected month spend 373,001 USD') while the rest of the UI uses the currency formatter ($15.6K)
The onboarding step bar shows only the numbers 1/2/3 with no labels
The header account switcher label is truncated ('COMBINE… / All platfor…')

action_items: Raise max_tokens for claude-sonnet-5-5 to about 3000-4000 (default in LlmGateway._chat/stream_live and the copilot call), or turn off extended thinking. Then check that narratives and Copilot answers end with finish_reason='stop'.
Change goal: keep onboarded=true when the workspace is already onboarded (or only set false on first-time onboarding), and prefill business name/ROAS/budget in GoalStep from the saved workspace.
Handle an empty frame in dataset.load_raw (unknown account_id/platform) so it does not return 500.
Use the same period for spend and budget in the synthesis brief (MTD/projected month vs monthly_budget), and use the workspace monthly_budget in the Budget opportunity.

Minor: sync the /agent textarea with the query started from Deep dive; queue or block Ask while Copilot is busy; give LinkedIn a distinct colour in the trend chart; use the money formatter in opportunity copy.
critical_code_review_comments: copilot.ask_stream: a bare 'except Exception' with no logging hides LLM failures and truncation.
WelcomePage: useState(ws?.goal) only uses the workspace on the first render. It works when the workspace is cached but is fragile; derive it from ws or reset it in an effect.
WelcomePage.saveGoal does not invalidate the 'workspace' query, so the client still has onboarded=true while the server has false.

rca of the issue: Truncation: /tmp/llm_probe.py called LlmChat.stream_message with with_params(max_tokens=900). The StreamDone finish_reason was 'length' with 0-150 visible words, because claude-sonnet-5-5 spends part of the budget on hidden reasoning. With max_tokens=3000 it was always 'stop'. Change-goal reset: WelcomePage.saveGoal hard-codes onboarded:false, and GoalStep useState('') for name/roas/budget means the PUT overwrites the saved values with null.
